verify:
select
  exists (
    select from pg_catalog.pg_proc p
    where p.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('public.sign_up_for_newsletter(text,text)')
      and p.proowner = (select relowner from pg_catalog.pg_class
        where oid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('private.helix_environment'))
      and p.prosecdef
      and p.prorettype = 'boolean'::regtype
      and p.proconfig = array['search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp']
      and encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc, 'UTF8')), 'hex') = 'd2062266e7b30dab3f1211b636a5dad1182d035e311ca01753105cece7a4af94'
      and has_function_privilege('service_role', p.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      and not has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      and not has_function_privilege(current_user, p.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      and not exists (select from aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a
        where a.grantee <> p.proowner and (a.grantee <> 'service_role'::regrole or a.is_grantable))
  )
  and 2 = (
    select count(*) from pg_catalog.pg_class c
    where c.oid in (pg_catalog.to_regclass('private.newsletter_signups'),
                    pg_catalog.to_regclass('private.newsletter_signup_limits'))
      and c.relowner = (select relowner from pg_catalog.pg_class
        where oid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('private.helix_environment'))
      and c.relrowsecurity and c.relforcerowsecurity
      and not exists (
        select from pg_catalog.pg_roles r
        where r.rolname in ('anon', 'authenticated', 'service_role', current_user)
          and (has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE')
            or has_any_column_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE'))
      )
      and exists (select from pg_catalog.pg_constraint k where k.conrelid = c.oid and k.contype = 'p')
  ) as applied
